queryStringParameters.description: The HTTP Query String Parameters in the URL

permissionLevel.description: The level the user's role is held at. The user must be a system admin for system, a member of the distributor for distributor, or a member of the region (directly or through its distributor) for region

id.description: System id 00000000-0000-4000-0000-000000000001 for permissionLevel system, otherwise the distributor or region id

maxPageSize.description: For paging. Counts organizations, not machines: a page holds the machines of at most this many organizations. Default 200, at most 1000

nextToken.description: For paging. Only used if given by an API response
